spec.source: references/Documents/09 - The Somerville Bowline - A4 print friendly.pdf
spec.scope: Isolated doubled locking-core fixture; exterior connector substitutes for the cuff ONLY to keep one physical path. It is not a reconstructed cuff.

assumptions.description: Loop in local XY with +Z passage normal; its lower root passes beneath its upper root. Dimensions, root sign, limb identity and orientation relative to the target are hypotheses.
A remote exterior connector joins standing and working portions of each limb. It must be replaced by the unchanged cuff arcs before full acceptance.
E0 follows limb 0 through the core to one fold, then limb 1 in reverse to E1. No limb exchange inside the fixture.

evidence.relation: Standing bundle owns loop after transfer; direct loop formation and first working passage are explicitly described.
Working bight passes over the X at the base of that loop.
Whole working bight passes beneath the entire cuff.
Bight returns through the loop in the same direction as its first passage.

recovery.interfaceStatus: ASSUMED; one fixed connector trial, no global fitting
